$comment: Phase 20 acceptance definition derived from architecture/phase-20-government-education-cloud.md, the phase contract, government-* modules and their four unit suites. Sovereign configuration and reports are represented and tested as typed libraries; no sovereign deployment or live statutory boundary is inferred.

ownership.note: Phase 20 owns residency configuration, jurisdiction policy packs and statutory report definitions. It never owns domain data, planetary infrastructure or globalization content.

areas.area: Government tenants and jurisdictions are explicit
areas.requirement: Government tenants, configurable jurisdiction hierarchies, federations and education networks require valid identity, scope and expiry data.

evidence.contains: creates active tenant with provided fields

areas.area: Policy, programme and emergency lifecycles are ordered
areas.requirement: Policies and programmes move only through legal states, funding is positive, approvals cannot repeat and emergency declarations require coherent affected-region data.

evidence.contains: rejects normal status with affected regions

areas.area: Government data exchange preserves purpose and residency
areas.requirement: Reports, data-sharing agreements, external systems, catalogs and residency policies carry purpose, stewards, approval and location controls; de-identification modes are explicit.

areas.area: Government operations retain compliance and outcome evidence
areas.requirement: Dashboards, SLOs, legal holds, compliance evidence, supplier risk, KPIs, warnings and AI registry entries have typed records and explicit acceptance/invariant structures.

areas.area: Sovereign placement and reporting remain unwired
areas.requirement: A tenant-authorized deployment and statutory reporting boundary must enforce residency and policy packs; current evidence proves only typed government libraries and tests.
